about_short_description.short_description: Halwani Bros is a manufacturer and distributor of food products.

product.name: Halwani Bros Jam
product.description: A range of fruit jams made from carefully selected fruits, intended for consumption as a sweet spread or ingredient.

product.name: Meat Products
product.description: An assortment of high-quality smoked and cooked meats including turkey, beef, and chicken for direct consumption or cooking.

product.name: Cheese
product.description: A variety of cheeses produced with specific aroma, texture, and taste characteristics for consumption and culinary use.

product.name: Halawa (Halva)
product.description: A traditional Middle Eastern sweet made from sesame seeds and other ingredients, offered in various flavors.

product.name: Tahina (Tahini)
product.description: A sesame seed paste used as a key ingredient in Middle Eastern cuisine and cooking.

product.name: Halwani Maamoul
product.description: A snack product consisting of filled pastries, available in various flavors and forms for convenient consumption.
